# International Fire & Safety Journal

> Leading global publication delivering breaking fire safety news, industry insights, and comprehensive coverage across regions and disciplines.

IFSJ is a professional B2B publication covering international fire safety news, industry standards, equipment innovations, and regional developments. The journal provides digital and print subscriptions, maintains a comprehensive news archive, and serves as a resource hub for fire safety professionals and industry stakeholders.

## News & Coverage

- [International Fire & Safety Journal](https://internationalfireandsafetyjournal.com): Homepage featuring breaking fire safety news and industry updates

- [News Archive](https://internationalfireandsafetyjournal.com/news/all): News archive with category filters and regional coverage
- [IFSJ Middle East & North Africa](https://internationalfireandsafetyjournal.com/ifsj-middle-east-north-africa): Fire & Safety news and coverage for Middle East and North Africa region
